```{=html}
            <g fill="var(--c-paper)"><circle cx="-7" cy="-7" r="3"/><circle cx="7" cy="7" r="3"/></g>
          </g>
        </g>
        <g class="part" data-part="dial">
          <circle r="30" fill="var(--c-panel-3)"/><circle r="22" fill="var(--c-metal)"/>
          <g stroke="var(--c-label)" stroke-width="2"><line x1="-24" y1="8" x2="-19" y2="6"/><line x1="0" y1="-26" x2="0" y2="-20"/><line x1="24" y1="8" x2="19" y2="6"/></g>
          <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="-14" y2="-14" stroke="var(--c-ink)" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle r="4" fill="var(--c-ink)"/>
          <text x="-40" y="4" text-anchor="end" class="tiny" style="font-size:8px">ask</text><text x="0" y="-33" text-anchor="middle" class="tiny" style="font-size:8px">plan</text><text x="40" y="4" class="tiny" style="font-size:8px">auto</text>
        </g>
        <g class="part" data-part="package">
          <rect x="-34" y="-26" width="68" height="56" fill="var(--c-mustard-3)"/>
          <rect x="-34" y="-26" width="68" height="56" fill="var(--c-mustard)" opacity="0.5"/>
          <rect x="-34" y="-4" width="68" height="10" fill="var(--c-paper)" opacity="0.85"/><rect x="-6" y="-26" width="12" height="56" fill="var(--c-paper)" opacity="0.85"/>
          <rect x="10" y="8" width="20" height="14" fill="var(--c-paper)"/><text x="12" y="19" class="tiny" style="font-size:8px;fill:#262c2d">v1.0</text>
        </g>
      </g>

      <!-- ===== the console: modeled in 3D by console.js, which draws its faces into #shell and fits each
           control to the face it sits on ===== -->
      <g id="console">
        <defs>
          <filter id="consoleShadow" x="-5%" y="-40%" width="110%" height="180%"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="4"/></filter>
        </defs>
        <g id="shell"></g>
        <g id="wingL"></g>
        <g id="wingR"></g>
        <g id="statusStrip"></g>
        <g id="centre"></g>
      </g>
    </svg>
</div>
<div class="console-legend" id="legend"></div>
<script src="console.js"></script>
```
